notes.title: JetX VR and JetX Space edition were heavily discounted and multiplayer event is coming!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35017872/5aa309ff0d06db3efc5fe54e9bf7cdd4b7fb1976.png[/img]
Get your copy today and rush into the world of epic competitions and arcade battles!

Let's play together and launch "JetX online weekend event" starting this week - 24-25 August!

For our old fans we are glad to announce that we have a lot of content that you might have missed before ;)

See you in battle! Join our discord - https://discord.gg/3ehWyJ

notes.title: Hooray! JetX Space Edition has been released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35017872/7bfe73f3574e5011af1c0cda880ccb82419b29c3.jpg[/img]
Try different modes, ranging from classic races, ending with crazy skirmishes with monsters!

A lot of people are already playing JetX. Do not miss the chance to become one of us!


Funny players, adrenaline racing and even more awaits you in JetX Space Edition: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1073640/JetX_Space_Edition/

notes.title: Are you ready for JetX?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35017872/e0783428c6ec0c8464e0a54622232991dcaaa930.png[/img]
Hey! JetX players! We have good news for you! We are releasing a Space edition of our game in 2 days, which can only be played with a PC!

Hurry up! Only in our game, you can compete in speed and also find out who is more accurate!

Don't forget to add JetX in your wishlist in Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1073640/JetX_Space_Edition/
